questions.question: Why does the excerpt show f(x)=3x+5 is one-to-one?

questions.answer: Because f(a)=f(b) leads to 3a+5=3b+5 and so a=b.

questions.question: Demonstrate in one algebraic step why f(x)=3x+5 is one-to-one as shown in the text.

questions.explanation: The excerpt shows that equating f(a) and f(b) leads to 3a+5=3b+5 and cancellation yields a=b, proving injectivity (section 'Example 1' under One-to-one function).
